summary: Interview with former hedge fund manager Torbjörn Olofsson about his new fund Quartile, which uses a 60-40 allocation approach with tactical risk factor overlays (momentum and value). Discussion about the challenges in hedge fund industry, the shift to passive investing with active strategies, and expectations for lower future market returns. No concrete stock recommendations were provided in the episode.
key_takeaways: Quartile uses 60% stocks and 40% bonds as baseline with tactical overlays
Value and momentum factors are used to handle market downturns and bubbles
Expected future returns of 3-5% rather than 7-10% due to structural changes
Risk in asset management has shifted from active to passive strategies over the last decade
Guest expresses skepticism about gold and prefers European over US stocks for contrarian value
